title.zh: Google Says It Just Cracked One of Quantum Computing's Biggest Bottlenecks
title.en: Google Says It Just Cracked One of Quantum Computing's Biggest Bottlenecks

current_state.zh: Google Quantum AI reported in Science that its magic state cultivation technique reduced errors roughly 40-fold on the Willow processor, producing magic states with 99.99% fidelity and advancing the path toward fault-tolerant, cryptographically relevant quantum computers.
current_state.en: Google Quantum AI reported in Science that its magic state cultivation technique reduced errors roughly 40-fold on the Willow processor, producing magic states with 99.99% fidelity and advancing the path toward fault-tolerant, cryptographically relevant quantum computers.
